title: Addition to 10
subtitle: Sums up to 10
bounds: Facts bounds (PROTOCOL 4c, briefs/facts2): the whole run inside sums 1 to 10, easy to hard by tier. Prompt forms: R 'a + b = ?' (answer s), C 'a + ? = s' (answer b), S '? + b = s' (answer a); every number a non-negative integer. T1 R, a or b <= 2 (0 allowed). T2 R, a, b >= 2. T3 R with a, b >= 3 (>= 8) plus C and S on the ten pairs a + (10 - a) (>= 4 each). T4 C, a, b >= 1. T5 S (>= 12) and C, a, b >= 2 and sums 5 to 10. Prompts unique per tier, 24 per tier. Wrong choices: distinct non-negative integers <= 999, >= 2 near the answer (+-1, +-2, +-10), at most 1 far; answer rank among the 4 values 15-35% each per tier; answers >= 20 always have a wrong choice sharing the ones digit (+-10); the answer is never the only value of its parity.

tiers.name: Plus 0, 1, 2
tiers.description: Adding 0, 1 or 2: the next number, or no change.

tiers.name: Sums to 10
tiers.description: Every sum up to 10 with both numbers 2 or more.

tiers.name: Make ten
tiers.description: Sums of 3 or more, and the pairs that make ten.

ONE_OFF.student: Off by one. Count again: start at the bigger number and count up.
ONE_OFF.teacher: Counted on wrong: the sum is one more or one less than the true sum.

SUBTRACTED.student: Plus means put together. Add the two numbers, don't take them apart.
SUBTRACTED.teacher: Subtracted the smaller addend from the larger instead of adding: 8 + 5 = 3.

MISSING_ADDED.student: Don't add the two numbers you see. Find the missing one: subtract.
MISSING_ADDED.teacher: Added the shown number and the total instead of subtracting: 7 + ? = 15 answered 22.

MISSING_ONE_OFF.student: Off by one. Add your answer to the shown number and check the total.
MISSING_ONE_OFF.teacher: Counted up wrong: the missing number is one more or one less than the true one.
